scores.label: A
scores.note: Options 1-5 are all 0 because each drops the date 'around 1440', and the instruction says to keep every number. Dropping 'Johannes' would be acceptable on its own. Option 3 also turns 'took a really long time' into 'a laborious task', which shifts the meaning. Options 4 and 5 read well but still lose the date. The five options are close rewordings of each other.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Options 1, 2 and 4 are 0 because they drop the date 1440. Option 4 also drops 'by hand' and turns the claim into 'slow to produce'. Options 3 and 5 are 0 because they drop Gutenberg and the press, which the next sentence ('After the press was invented') depends on, and they turn 'around 1440' into a firm 'before 1440'. Option 5 also weakens 'a really long time' to 'took time'. Option 2 ('pre-Gutenberg') reads as casual for an essay.

scores.label: C
scores.note: Options 1 and 2 are 0 because they change 'around 1440' to an exact 'in 1440' or '1440 press', which makes the claim more certain than the original. Option 3 keeps every fact and the certainty but only trims 'really', so it is usable but barely shorter. Options 4 and 5 failed as duplicates and were not judged.

scores.label: D
scores.note: Option 2 keeps every fact, the name and 'around 1440', but it is only one word shorter. Splitting it into two sentences ('Before this...') is a little choppy, and 'books... took a very long time' is slightly loose. It is usable. Options 1 and 3-5 failed (not shorter, or duplicates) and were not judged.

scores.label: E
scores.note: Option 1 is 0 because it drops Gutenberg, the press and the claim about time. Option 2 is 0 because it drops the date 1440. Options 3, 4 and 5 are 0 because they drop Gutenberg and the press and change 'around 1440' to a firm 'before 1440'. Options 3-5 are near copies of each other, and all of them weaken 'a really long time' to 'slow'.
